title: US Bank Industry Earnings Highest Since 2006: FDIC
主要内容: The U.S. banking industry recorded its highest earnings since before the 2007-2009 financial crisis in 2012, according to the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp. Full-year earnings reached $141.3 billion, a 19.3 percent increase from 2011. The FDIC attributed much of the growth to reduced loan loss provisions and gains from loan sales and higher servicing income. In the fourth quarter of 2012, earnings totaled $34.7 billion, up 36.9 percent from the same period in 2011. Net operating revenue rose 4.5 percent to $169 billion. While the report signals recovery from the financial crisis, some larger banks cut jobs to address persistent challenges like declining trading volumes.
